reviews.comment: Angelique is genuinely the BEST professor I have ever had at TAMU. She cares about her students on another level. She is a tough grader, BUT she clearly explains why something is wrong and she gives extra credit oppurtunities all the time. I will definitely be taking her again if I can. Build a relationship with her and she will take care of you!

Professor Gammon is a great teacher and has years of experience in the journalism field, so she knows exactly what she's talking about! The class includes weekly writing assignments and a final longform article, and it definitely gets overwhelming, but Gammon is always available to help and breaks down assignments easily. Just be ready to write!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved every bit of her class, participating matters to her. You have to earn her respect or you'll be in for a long semester. As long as you show up and ask questions you'll get a easy A! But she's super caring towards students and learned a lot in her class this semester and would definitely take her again!

Angelique is one of the best professors I have ever had. She genuinely wants to see her students succeed and will do anything to help them. If you're interested in Journalism as a profession, she is the person to prepare you!

Prof. Gammon is an amazing person and a great teacher. She is VERY high-energy and will probably stress you out at times, but she is always a fair grader and you will really learn a lot in her classes. I've had her twice and her classes were probably the most demanding ones I took during the semester, but I learned so much so I don't regret it!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you are interested in journalism AT ALL, take Prof. Gammon! It's definitely not a blow-off class, but it's a lot of fun! She's an excellent teacher, gives GREAT feedback, and is a pretty lenient grader unless you make an error that she has repeatedly corrected. She is an authentically nice person who is passionate about what she teaches!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Angelique is such a helpful prof. I've learned a lot from her in class and with our 1-on-1s. This class is obviously a lot of writing but she grades easily as long as you show that you put effort. There is a long form article due at the end that can be a little intimidating, but she makes the process a lot smoother.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Angelique is the best professor you will ever have. I dont believe a more caring, thorough or accessible professor exists. 1-on-1 time with her was by far the most beneficial thing I have had as a student. She will not let you fail if you just reach out to her. Just incredible.
she is a tough grader and there is so much work to do and she lectures for the full 3 hours but doesn't actually teach you anything
She is very tough and this class is a lot of work

reviews.comment: The class is obviously a lot of work no matter what, it is a 3 hour writing lab. Angelique make this class so great and I have learned more from her than from any other Professor. The topics we cover are interesting and she has amazing contacts around cstat to help you. She will teach you to be a better journalist writer and you'll have fun!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Angelique is one of the best professors that I have ever had. This class was hard but learned a lot from her. She does not want you to fail. I can't wait to take another class with her!

Angelique is the best professor you will ever have. Everything she teaches is applicable to the real world. Every student in the class respects her, even if they're scared of her. She genuinely cares that you learn how to develop real skills and aren't left in the dark. Every class is exciting and different. Don't be afraid to talk to her.
